name: Is crack filling enough, or do I need to re-stucco the entire wall?

mainEntity.name: Is crack filling enough, or do I need to re-stucco the entire wall?

acceptedAnswer.text: Crack filling is typically sufficient for isolated, non-structural cracks. However, if the stucco has extensive cracking, widespread delamination, significant moisture damage, or shows signs of widespread structural failure, re-stuccoing the entire wall or section may be a more appropriate and durable solution. A professional evaluation can determine the extent of damage and recommend the most effective course of action for your specific situation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Crack filling is good for isolated issues; re-stuccoing is needed for widespread damage, delamination, or structural failure.
